description: Luw.ai Segment AI: detect objects in a photo and return black-and-white masks as image URLs — every object (wall, floor, sofa, …) or only what you describe in prompt. Feed a mask URL into luw_magic_wand or luw_landscape_design to edit exactly that area. Costs 1 credit.

image.description: Photo to segment (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

labels.description: Keep only masks whose label contains one of these words (e.g. ["floor", "wall"]).

prompt.description: What to segment, e.g. "walls", "the sofa", "lawn". Omit to segment everything.

name: luw_segment
title: Segment objects into masks (Segment AI)
